text "# Sends selected photos to a Flickr set the user chooses. # Flickr sets: keep selected Yaffo photos in Flickr photosets. # # A custom adapter (OAuth 1.0a, the user's own Flickr app). Each routing target is a # set: the set the user picked, or one titled after the target, created when missing. # Flickr creates a set with its first photo, so a new set's first upload is already in # it. Uploads are private (hidden from public searches); Flickr answers an upload in # XML, and everything else in JSON with \"stat\": \"ok\" or \"fail\" (failures are HTTP 200). # # Removing takes the photo out of its set and deletes it from Flickr, since Yaffo # uploaded it. REST = \"https://api.flickr.com/services/rest\" UPLOAD = \"https://up.flickr.com/services/upload/\" def _error(r): if r[\"status\"] == 0: return {\"code\": \"retry_later\", \"message\": r.get(\"error\", \"network\")} if r[\"status\"] == 401 or r[\"status\"] == 403: return {\"code\": \"auth\", \"message\": \"Flickr refused the account\"} body = r.get(\"json\") if type(body) == \"dict\" and body.get(\"stat\") == \"fail\": if body.get(\"code\") == 98 or body.get(\"code\") == 99: return {\"code\": \"auth\", \"message\": \"Flickr: \" + body.get(\"message\", \"\")} return {\"code\": \"retry_later\", \"message\": \"Flickr: %s (%s)\" % (body.get(\"message\", \"\"), body.get(\"code\"))} return {\"code\": \"retry_later\", \"message\": \"Flickr answered %d\" % r[\"status\"]} def _ok(r): return r[\"status\"] == 200 and type(r.get(\"json\")) == \"dict\" and r[\"json\"].get(\"stat\") == \"ok\" def _fail_code(r): body = r.get(\"json\") return body.get(\"code\") if type(body) == \"dict\" else None def _read(method, params): query = {\"method\": method, \"format\": \"json\", \"nojsoncallback\": \"1\"} query.update(params) return web_request(CONNECTION, \"GET\", REST, query=query) def _write(method, params): query = {\"method\": method, \"format\": \"json\", \"nojsoncallback\": \"1\"} query.update(params) return web_request(CONNECTION, \"POST\", REST, query=query) def _upload_error(up): text = up.get(\"text\") or \"\" if up[\"status\"] == 200 and ('<err code=\"98\"' in text or '<err code=\"99\"' in text): return {\"code\": \"auth\", \"message\": \"Flickr refused the account\"} return _error(up) def _photo_id(text): start = text.find(\"<photoid>\") end = text.find(\"</photoid>\") if start < 0 or end < start: return None return text[start + len(\"<photoid>\"):end].strip() def _set_title(target, ctx): pinned = ctx[\"options\"].get(\"set\") if pinned and pinned.get(\"new\"): return pinned[\"label\"] return target def _existing_sets(): r = _read(\"flickr.photosets.getList\", {\"per_page\": \"500\"}) if not _ok(r): return {\"error\": _error(r)} found = {} for photoset in r[\"json\"][\"photosets\"].get(\"photoset\", []): found[photoset[\"title\"][\"_content\"]] = photoset[\"id\"] return {\"sets\": found} def push(batch, ctx): sets = dict(ctx[\"state\"].get(\"sets\") or {}) pinned = ctx[\"options\"].get(\"set\") results = [] grouped = {} for item in batch: grouped.setdefault(_set_title(item[\"target\"], ctx), []).append(item) for title, items in grouped.items(): uploaded = [] for item in items: up = web_upload_media(CONNECTION, \"POST\", UPLOAD, item[\"media_item_id\"], encoding=\"multipart\", field=\"photo\", fields={\"title\": item[\"filename\"], \"description\": item[\"caption\"] or \"\", \"is_public\": \"0\", \"is_friend\": \"0\", \"is_family\": \"0\", \"hidden\": \"2\"}) photo_id = _photo_id(up.get(\"text\") or \"\") if up[\"status\"] == 200 else None if not photo_id: error = _upload_error(up) if error[\"code\"] == \"auth\": return {\"results\": results, \"state_patch\": {\"sets\": sets}, \"error\": error} results.append({\"key\": item[\"key\"], \"error\": error}) continue uploaded.append((item, photo_id)) if not uploaded: continue set_id = pinned[\"id\"] if pinned and pinned.get(\"id\") else sets.get(title) primary = None if not set_id: existing = _existing_sets() if existing.get(\"error\"): return {\"results\": results, \"state_patch\": {\"sets\": sets}, \"error\": existing[\"error\"]} set_id = existing[\"sets\"].get(title) if not set_id: primary = uploaded[0][1] created = _write(\"flickr.photosets.create\", {\"title\": title, \"primary_photo_id\": primary}) if not _ok(created): return {\"results\": results, \"state_patch\": {\"sets\": sets}, \"error\": _error(created)} set_id = created[\"json\"][\"photoset\"][\"id\"] sets[title] = set_id for item, photo_id in uploaded: if photo_id != primary: added = _write(\"flickr.photosets.addPhoto\", {\"photoset_id\": set_id, \"photo_id\": photo_id}) if not _ok(added) and _fail_code(added) != 3: # 3: already in the set results.append({\"key\": item[\"key\"], \"error\": _error(added)}) continue results.append({\"key\": item[\"key\"], \"remote_id\": photo_id, \"details\": {\"photoset_id\": set_id, \"uploaded\": True}}) return {\"results\": results, \"state_patch\": {\"sets\": sets}} def remove(items, ctx): results = [] for item in items: details = item.get(\"details\") or {} if item.get(\"remote_id\") and details.get(\"photoset_id\"): out = _write(\"flickr.photosets.removePhoto\", {\"photoset_id\": details[\"photoset_id\"], \"photo_id\": item[\"remote_id\"]}) if not _ok(out) and _fail_code(out) not in (1, 2): # 1, 2: the set or photo is gone already return {\"results\": results, \"error\": _error(out)} if item.get(\"remote_id\") and details.get(\"uploaded\"): out = _write(\"flickr.photos.delete\", {\"photo_id\": item[\"remote_id\"]}) if not _ok(out) and _fail_code(out) != 1: # 1: already deleted return {\"results\": results, \"error\": _error(out)} results.append({\"key\": item[\"key\"]}) return {\"results\": results} def list_remote(cursor, ctx): targets_of = {} for item in ctx.get(\"reconcile_items\") or []: set_id = (item.get(\"details\") or {}).get(\"photoset_id\") or (ctx[\"state\"].get(\"sets\") or {}).get( _set_title(item[\"target\"], ctx)) if set_id: targets_of.setdefault(set_id, {})[item[\"target\"]] = True keys = sorted(targets_of.keys()) index = int(cursor) if cursor else 0 if index >= len(keys): return {\"items\": [], \"next_cursor\": None} set_id = keys[index] r = _read(\"flickr.photosets.getPhotos\", {\"photoset_id\": set_id, \"per_page\": \"500\"}) next_cursor = str(index + 1) if index + 1 < len(keys) else None if _fail_code(r) == 1: # the set is gone return {\"items\": [], \"next_cursor\": next_cursor} if not _ok(r): return {\"error\": _error(r)} found = [{\"remote_id\": photo[\"id\"], \"target\": target, \"filename\": photo.get(\"title\"), \"details\": {\"photoset_id\": set_id}} for photo in r[\"json\"][\"photoset\"].get(\"photo\", []) for target in targets_of[set_id].keys()] return {\"items\": found, \"next_cursor\": next_cursor} def choices(option, parent_id, cursor, ctx): existing = _existing_sets() if existing.get(\"error\"): return {\"error\": existing[\"error\"]} return {\"items\": [{\"id\": set_id, \"label\": title, \"has_children\": False} for title, set_id in existing[\"sets\"].items()], \"next_cursor\": None} ADAPTER = { \"contract\": 1, \"role\": \"target\", \"provider\": \"custom\", \"title\": \"Flickr sets\", \"description\": \"Keep selected photos in Flickr sets, uploaded as private photos.\", \"connection\": { \"auth_kind\": \"oauth1a\", \"auth\": {\"request_token_url\": \"https://www.flickr.com/services/oauth/request_token\", \"authorize_url\": \"https://www.flickr.com/services/oauth/authorize\", \"access_token_url\": \"https://www.flickr.com/services/oauth/access_token\", \"authorize_params\": {\"perms\": \"delete\"}, \"sign_multipart_fields\": True}, \"redirect\": \"registered\", \"app_credentials\": [\"client_id\", \"client_secret\"], \"app_form_labels\": {\"redirect\": \"Callback URL\", \"client_id\": \"Key\", \"client_secret\": \"Secret\"}, \"base_urls\": [\"https://api.flickr.com\", \"https://up.flickr.com\"], \"check\": {\"method\": \"GET\", \"url\": \"https://api.flickr.com/services/rest?method=flickr.test.login&format=json&nojsoncallback=1\", \"account_id\": \"user.id\", \"account_label\": [\"user.username._content\"]}, }, \"options\": {\"set\": {\"type\": \"remote_collection\", \"label\": \"Flickr set\", \"create\": True, \"help\": \"Choose a set, or name a new one. Leave empty to name it after the selection.\"}}, \"capabilities\": {\"max_batch\": 10, \"remove\": True, \"reconcile\": True, \"targets\": \"many\", \"accepts\": {\"types\": [\"image/jpeg\", \"image/png\", \"image/gif\", \"image/tiff\", \"video/mp4\", \"video/quicktime\"], \"max_bytes\": 200000000}}, \"hooks\": {\"push\": push, \"remove\": remove, \"list_remote\": list_remote, \"choices\": choices}, }" 767×3545
